description:
List what a key can be listed for

What a key can be listed for. Today: custom, your own OpenAI-compatible server (any model it serves), and zai with a GLM Coding Plan key. The other vendors (OpenAI, Google AI Studio, DeepSeek, Moonshot, and Z.ai open platform keys) are listed with `comingSoon: true`: a key for one is refused (422 preset_coming_soon). Each vendor carries a one-line terms check (make sure your vendor's terms allow it) and a link to that vendor's terms page. Each carries the short statement the seller accepts before a key goes live (the key is yours, you allow serving other customers' requests, your vendor account is your responsibility) and its version. OAuth and session tokens are never accepted.
